research_questions.statement: What mechanism should be tested next to reduce the remaining unsupported scientific-evidence residual while preserving already validated local evidence behavior?
research_questions.decision_target: Select the next bounded scientific experiment class, not a production architecture.
research_questions.objective: Reduce uncertainty about why five target atoms remain unsupported after the strongest validated lexical-preservation result.

residuals.statement: The strongest validated proposition-alignment mechanism supports 8/13 target atoms, leaving five unsupported while preserving all 7/7 frozen controls.

hypotheses.statement: Some unsupported targets remain unsupported because the necessary evidence is absent from the bounded candidate evidence set.
predictions: An evidence-availability oracle would fail to locate sufficient support for at least some unsupported targets within the current bounded candidate set.
falsifiers: A teacher-blind or independently labeled availability diagnostic establishes that sufficient support is present for all unsupported targets inside the bounded candidate set.

hypotheses.statement: Sufficient evidence is present, but lexical proposition alignment misses semantically equivalent or related evidence.
predictions: A valid semantic representation should add safe non-lexical matches while preserving accepted controls.
falsifiers: Multiple materially distinct semantic-certificate representations fail to expose a safe operating point under independent validation.

hypotheses.statement: Some unsupported targets require bounded composition over multiple evidence units rather than one-to-one proposition substitution.
predictions: A bounded evidence-set diagnostic should recover support that no single candidate unit can provide while preserving accepted controls.
falsifiers: A ceiling diagnostic establishes that bounded multi-unit evidence provides no additional support beyond the best single units.

hypotheses.statement: Some unsupported targets need to be decomposed into explicit evidence obligations before retrieval or evidence-set reasoning can succeed.
predictions: A decomposition/oracle diagnostic should expose separable missing obligations whose satisfaction changes support coverage.
falsifiers: Independent obligation decomposition produces no additional discriminative retrieval or support signal.

hypotheses.statement: Relevant evidence exists and is individually recognizable, but the bounded selection policy discards it while optimizing a proxy objective.
predictions: Oracle replacement or counterfactual selection under the same evidence pool should improve support without changing representation quality.
falsifiers: Counterfactual selection cannot improve support when representation and evidence pool are held fixed.

assumptions.statement: A general pairwise semantic score can expose a high-precision, nontrivial-recall threshold suitable for redundancy certification.
The accepted lexical proposition-alignment mechanism is useful positive evidence that should be preserved by default.

mechanism_families.name: Direct lexical proposition preservation
mechanism_families.premise: A bounded lexical proposition-level redundancy signal can identify safe replacements while preserving already-supported evidence.

mechanism_families.name: Pairwise semantic redundancy certificate
mechanism_families.premise: A semantic model or representation can assign a pairwise score with a safe high-precision, nontrivial-recall operating point for certifying proposition redundancy.

mechanism_families.name: Coverage-preserving evidence composition
mechanism_families.premise: Complementary evidence selection can recover missing support while preserving a strong baseline under a fixed evidence budget.

evidence_items.statement: MULTIVIEW_SUBMODULAR_COVERAGE_DIAGNOSTIC_V1 returned COMPOSITION_NEGATIVE; the verdict-eligible selector supported 4/13 targets and retained 2/7 frozen controls.
evidence_items.notes: Date-level timestamp only in this snapshot.

evidence_items.statement: ZERO_LOSS_RESIDUAL_AUGMENTATION_DIAGNOSTIC_V1 returned PROTECTED_AUGMENT_NEGATIVE; teacher-blind source-aware utility preservation did not preserve semantic teacher evidence.
evidence_items.notes: Date-level timestamp only in this snapshot.

evidence_items.statement: DYNAMIC_SAME_PAGE_ALIGNMENT_SWAP_V1 returned ALIGNMENT_AUGMENT_FEASIBLE with 8/13 target support, all 7/7 frozen controls retained, e6.a recovered, and full page-ceiling preservation.
evidence_items.notes: Strongest validated positive preservation checkpoint in this snapshot.

evidence_items.statement: SCIENTIFIC_NLI_REDUNDANCY_CERTIFICATE_VALIDATION_V1 returned NLI_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED because no frozen SPARK threshold met precision>=0.95 and recall>=0.05.
evidence_items.notes: SciNLI discrimination did not override redundancy-safety failure.

evidence_items.statement: DEPENDENCY_PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_VALIDATION_V1 returned PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED; no safe SPARK threshold existed and FOBIE held-out relation recall was 4/153.
evidence_items.notes: 100% sentence unit coverage did not rescue relation fidelity.

evidence_items.statement: AMR_GRAPH_CERTIFICATE_VALIDATION_V1 returned AMR_GRAPH_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED; Bio-AMR corpus Smatch F1 was 0.3783772311 versus 0.60 and SPARK selected no safe calibration threshold.
evidence_items.notes: Independent reviewer confirmed the frozen rejection verdict.

evidence_items.statement: The first AMR trigger failed during packaging before parser/model/data scientific execution; scientific status was NOT_RUN.
evidence_items.notes: This is execution evidence, not negative scientific evidence.

invariants.statement: Preserve the validated lexical proposition-alignment behavior by default: 8/13 target support with 7/7 frozen controls retained and e6.a recovered.

scientific_results.statement: The tested learned mutual-entailment certificate did not satisfy the frozen safe-redundancy gate.
The tested dependency predicate/argument certificate failed both safe redundancy calibration and scientific relation fidelity.
The tested AMR graph certificate failed scientific-domain fidelity and safe redundancy calibration.
The first AMR execution failed before scientific scoring and therefore did not update scientific beliefs.

changes: Close mf-pairwise-semantic-certificate in the methodology-side research model because three materially distinct implementations produced negative evidence and two independently failed the same safe-calibration premise.
Keep h-retrieval-absence, h-evidence-composition, h-obligation-decomposition, and h-selection-policy open.
belief_updates.next_priority_uncertainty: Determine which non-certificate explanation best accounts for the remaining five unsupported targets before selecting another architecture.

stopping_rules.condition: Multiple materially distinct semantic-certificate representations fail premise-relevant external gates, including repeated failure to expose the frozen high-precision/nontrivial-recall safe operating point.
stopping_rules.action: Close the mechanism family in the methodology-side model; do not test another pairwise semantic-certificate implementation without premise-changing evidence.

reopening_conditions.required_new_evidence: Evidence must change the failed premise, such as demonstrating that prior validation was invalid, establishing a materially different decision rule that does not depend on the failed safe-threshold assumption, or changing the research objective so that the original gate is no longer relevant. A newer model or parameter retune alone is insufficient.

decisions.statement: Carry the accepted lexical proposition-alignment result forward as a default preservation obligation.
decisions.rationale: It is the strongest validated positive preservation result and retains every frozen control.

decisions.statement: Close the pairwise semantic redundancy-certificate family in the methodology-side shadow model pending premise-changing evidence.
decisions.rationale: NLI, dependency predicate/argument, and AMR are materially different representations, yet all provide negative evidence against the family; NLI and AMR/predicate-argument repeatedly fail the same safe-calibration premise.

decisions.statement: The next methodology-side question is which non-certificate residual explanation should be discriminated, not which semantic representation to try next.
decisions.rationale: The certificate family is closed in the shadow model while multiple residual explanations remain open.

provenance.hindsight_disclosure: This snapshot is a methodology-side reconstruction created after the AMR result and therefore cannot validate prospective predictive quality. It must not choose or mutate the EXTRACT owner's next architecture.
provenance.notes: Evidence is derived from durable EXTRACT task checkpoints and independent-review state. Some historical evidence observed_at timestamps are date-level placeholders because exact event times were not required for this first schema exercise.
